languages.text: "Какой смелый эксперимент! Безрассудный, но смелый. Декабалус-4-16 всегда обладал особым виденьем, и я не исключаю, что именно здесь он мог рискнуть претворить его в жизнь".
"What a daring experiment! Reckless, yet bold. Decabalus-4-16 always had a unique vision, and I do not dismiss the possibility that it was here that he dared to bring it to life."

languages.text: 「なんと大胆な実験でしょう！無謀でありながら、果敢だ。デカバルス4-16は常に独自の展望を抱いていました。彼がその展望を、まさにこの場所で敢えて実現させた――その可能性を、私は否定しません」
languages.original_text: "What a daring experiment! Reckless, yet bold. Decabalus-4-16 always had a unique vision, and I do not dismiss the possibility that it was here that he dared to bring it to life."

languages.text: "Was für ein kühnes Experiment! Leichtsinnig, aber mutig. Decabalus-4-16 hatte immer eine einzigartige Vision und ich möchte nicht ausschließen, dass er sie hier in die Tat umgesetzt hat."

languages.text: «¡Qué experimento tan atrevido! Temerario, pero audaz. Decabalus-4-16 siempre ha tenido una visión única, y no descarto la posibilidad de que solo aquí se atreviera a darle vida».
languages.original_text: "What a daring experiment! Reckless, yet bold. Decabalus-4-16 always had a unique vision, and I do not dismiss the possibility that it was here that he dared to bring it to life."

languages.text: "Ne cüretkâr bir deney! Pervasız ama cesur. Decabalus-4-16'nın her zaman benzersiz bir vizyonu vardı. Onu hayata geçirmeye tam da burada cüret etmiş olması ihtimalini göz ardı etmiyorum."

languages.text: “多么大胆的实验！鲁莽，但充满魄力。德卡巴洛斯-4-16向来眼光独到。我有理由相信，他就是在这里，才敢于将自己的构想付诸实践。”

languages.text: « Une expérience audacieuse ! Imprudente, mais courageuse. Décabalus-4-16 a toujours eu une vision unique, et je n'écarte pas la possibilité que c'est ici qu'il a enfin osé lui donner vie. »
